title: fix(runtime): the standalone host refuses an opaque-scheme OS_DATABASE_URL, and a .wasm.db ending no longer rescues an unrecognised scheme
body:
Fixes #23765

Clause-②: no

## What

The runtime's standalone host (`detectDriverFromUrl` in `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts`) now refuses two URL shapes it used to open as a SQLite file at a path made of the URL. Both broke the module header's own rule (`standalone-stack.ts:34`): "Unknown URL schemes throw — we never silently fall back to sqlite".

- **An opaque scheme**: two or more characters and a `:` with no `//` (`jdbc:postgresql://…`, `redis:h`). The scheme-less arm read "no `SCHEME://`" as "a file path".
- **A scheme rescued by a `.wasm.db` ending** (`redis://h/x.wasm.db`). The `.wasm.db` test ran ahead of every scheme check. It now selects the WASM engine only for a `file:` URL or a value with no scheme.

Both meet the existing unsupported-scheme refusal, unchanged: plain `Error`, same words, naming the scheme only. A single letter and a `:` stays a Windows drive path. `file:`, `sqlite:`, plain paths, `wasm-sqlite://` and `:memory:` resolve as before.

Files:
- `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts`: `detectDriverFromUrl` only (the `.wasm.db` test moves under the `file:` and no-scheme returns; the scheme computation gains the opaque-scheme fallback).
- `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-opaque-scheme-refusal.test.ts` (new): pins beside the existing standalone database-URL tests.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/driver-vocabulary-parity.test.ts`: the four rows that named this card move into the "both hosts REFUSE" block. That block now also asserts the runtime names the same scheme as the CLI. Two drive-letter rows join the "both hosts ACCEPT" block as the control. The CLI-only block is deleted.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/storage-driver.ts`: comments only (commit `5866f58f4`). The `inferDriverTypeFromUrl` docblock and its opaque-scheme arm comment described this card's gap as open; they now say both hosts refuse an opaque scheme, naming the scheme, and `driver-vocabulary-parity.test.ts` holds the two equal. No other line of the file changes.
- `.changeset/23765-opaque-scheme-refusal.md`: `@objectstack/runtime` patch.

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **One rule, two hosts.** The CLI's rule after PR #23761 is written inline in `inferDriverTypeFromUrl` (`packages/cli/src/utils/storage-driver.ts`): the `SCHEME://` regex, falling back to the opaque regex `/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]+:/i`. No package both hosts depend on has an opaque-scheme classifier. `git grep` of that regex over `packages/` (tests excluded) has one hit, the CLI's own. `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/types` have no such classifier. The runtime cannot import from the CLI, which depends on it. A shared copy would need a new runtime export plus an edit to `storage-driver.ts`, which the claim holds off. So this PR writes the runtime's arm with the same regex, character for character, and the parity rows hold the two hosts equal.
2. **Who reads the answer.** `detectDriverFromUrl` is module-private, with one call site: `resolveStandaloneDatabase`. That function feeds `createStandaloneStack` and, in the CLI, `migrate-occupancy-gate.ts`, `schema-migrate.ts` and `telemetry-datasource.ts`. In-repo producers, at `3fed1eb00`:
   - `git grep -n "jdbc:"`, excluding CHANGELOGs: 9 hits. All are CLI refusal pins, CLI comments or the sibling changeset.
   - Scheme-prefixed `*.wasm.db` literals: 15 hits. 2 `file:` and 6 `sqlite:` (positive control), and 7 others, all CLI refusal pins, comments or the changeset.
   - URL literals assigned to a URL key across `packages examples apps content scripts`: 2,703. Of these, 367 start with `file:` or `sqlite:` (positive control). The opaque-scheme values that remain do not reach this host: driver-turso constructor tests (`libsql:db.example.turso.io`), a banner display string, `data:` / `javascript:` / `pkg:` literals, and grep noise.

   No producer, example or fixture that this refusal now breaks.
3. **The refusal's shape.** This PR reuses the existing throw and does not edit it. The pins compare against a reference refusal (`wat://nope`) rather than pinning prose: same constructor (`Error`), same own property names, same `code` (none; this refusal has no ADR-0112 code), and the same message once the scheme is masked. The first sentence names the scheme. A placeholder credential (`PLACEHOLDER-USER` / `PLACEHOLDER-SECRET` / `PLACEHOLDER-TOKEN`) appears in no own property of the error.
4. **Reproduction at the public door.** `os serve --dev` over a plain config, each run in a fresh scratch directory outside the repo:

   | `OS_DATABASE_URL` | base `3fed1eb00` | this branch |
   |---|---|---|
   | `jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:5999/db` | `✓ Server is ready`, `Driver: SqlDriver(better-sqlite3) → jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:5999/db`; created `./jdbc:postgresql:/127.0.0.1:5999/db` (+ telemetry siblings) | exit 1 after `Loading objectstack.config.ts...`: `✗ [StandaloneStack] Unsupported database URL scheme "jdbc:". Supported schemes: …`; directory holds only the config |
   | `redis://h/x.wasm.db` | `✓ Server is ready`; created `./redis:/h/x.wasm.db` | exit 1, `… scheme "redis://"`; nothing created |
   | `redis:h` | `✓ Server is ready`; created `./redis:h` (+ telemetry siblings) | exit 1, `… scheme "redis:"`; nothing created |

   CONTROL on this branch: `file:./x.db`, `sqlite:./x.db` and `./x.db` boot ready on `./x.db`, `./x.wasm.db` boots ready on `./x.wasm.db`, and `:memory:` boots ready on `:memory:`. `C:\data\x.db` and `C:/data/x.db` are pinned as string fixtures (sqlite, same file).

Round 2 (`5866f58f4`, comment-only, after the seat's REWORK `6212986188`): the parity and `storage-driver` unit files 164 passed, cli `typecheck` exit 0, gate union 64 run / 1 NOT-MEASURED (`check:type-check-debt`, CI's), CI all success. The sections below cite round 1 at `c01539665` for the runtime readings, whose files this round does not touch.

## Tests (final head `c01539665`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 400 passed (400)`, `Tests 6026 passed | 19 skipped (6045)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`; the new test file adds no debt).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/driver-vocabulary-parity.test.ts src/utils/storage-driver.test.ts`: `2 passed`, `164 passed`, exit 0. The parity file resolves `@objectstack/runtime` through `dist/`, rebuilt from this head (the opaque regex is present in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed source files: exit 0, no output.
- The CLI's `integration` tier is left to CI; this diff touches no integration-layer file and no spawn entry. The runtime's `repo` project (`test:repo`) is left to CI (`Test Core`); this diff touches none of its three files.

**Ablation.** The pin file imports `./standalone-stack.js` from source, so no rebuild was needed. Mutations went through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode, restore proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
- Opaque arm: `urlSchemeOf(dbUrl) ?? /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]+:/i.exec(dbUrl)?.[0]` reverted to `urlSchemeOf(dbUrl)`. Blob `7fe20179cd6d` to `2d4dd5eb306e`. Result: `Tests 21 failed | 26 passed (47)`: all 18 opaque rows across the three doors, plus the 3 `jdbc:x/app.wasm.db` rows. CONTROL stayed green. Restored.
- `.wasm.db` position (the early return put back ahead of `file:`):
  - The first attempt was refused by the tool itself (the replacement contained the anchor, so the count went 1 to 1). No test ran.
  - The second attempt landed and read `9 failed | 38 passed`. The credentialed `redis://…` row stayed green: its URL ended in a `?authToken=` query, so it never exercised the rescue. Commit `60575c3df` moves the token into the path.
  - The rerun read `12 failed | 35 passed (47)`: every rescue row across the three doors. Restored.

## Gates (final head `c01539665`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (merge base `1eac7ad75`, 4 paths) derived 65 commands. 64 ran with exit 0.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` was not run on this head: NOT MEASURED. On the first pass my 590 s foreground timeout killed it (exit 124). That kill interrupted its closure refresh mid-build and left `@objectstack/organizations` with a `dist/` missing `index.d.ts`. `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` read that state red on the second pass. I rebuilt that package, and both reran exit 0. CI runs `check:type-check-debt` in `Type Check · debt ledger`.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0.
- The repo-wide lint run belongs to this PR's `Lint & Repo Gates` check-run.

## Acceptance notes

- **The runtime's refusal lists fewer schemes than the CLI's.** Its "Supported schemes" list names neither `wasm-sqlite://` nor "a path with no scheme"; the CLI's list names both. That is polish, so not filed.
- **A declared datasource's URL is not normalized.** On the config-datasource tier the URL is not passed through `normalizeDatabaseUrl`, so a non-sqlite declared datasource whose `url` is `sqlite:./x.db` is now refused as `"sqlite:"`. By reading, not measured: before this PR it opened a file literally named `sqlite:./x.db`, and `sqlite://` was already refused on that tier. No in-repo producer writes it.
- **`main` moved after my merge.** It moved 8 commits past `1eac7ad75`, among them `f7a5ebed7` and `ae4dfafa1` (PR #23843), which edit other functions of `standalone-stack.ts`. `git merge-tree` reports a clean merge with disjoint hunks. The incoming test (`standalone-stack-uncreatable-db-directory.test.ts`) uses only `file:` and `wasm-sqlite://` URLs, which this change leaves alone. PR CI runs on the merge ref.
- **Out-of-scope finding, reported to the seat and not fixed here.** An explicit `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER=sqlite` skips `detectDriverFromUrl` and reaches `sqliteFilenameFromUrl`, which recognises only `SCHEME://`. Measured at the door on this branch: `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER=sqlite OS_DATABASE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:5999/db os serve --dev` still boots ready on `./jdbc:postgresql:/127.0.0.1:5999/db`, while `redis://h/x.db` is refused. That function is held off here (#23794 and #23796 are the open cards on it), so this shape goes to the seat for that family.

The body edits of round 2 (the `storage-driver.ts` file bullet, the round-2 line, and the removed stale Acceptance note) were written by the `domain:cli` seat 2 PM (session `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT`) from the dev's round-2 report.
